notes.title: Lucid Update Released
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:
- The automatic screen mode detection has been removed, since on some graphics cards it caused problems.

notes.title: Lucid Update Released
notes.notes:
Fixed: Fullscreen aspect ratio fixed.
Fixed: Added Delete Save Data button
Fixed: Start Game button continues from your saved game.
Fixed: Minor sound effect glitches.

notes.title: New Release - Lucid 20% off
notes.notes:
Lucid is now available and is 20% off until July 26th 10AM Pacific Time.

Lucid is the world's first Match-All puzzle game, in which you clear areas by combining all the blocks of an area. Enjoy the stunning visuals and relaxing sound effects as you make combos and hunt for the next perfect area to clear.
